**brief:** the `test-bodies` probe now runs inside the brief's own process as a Rust step (`execution_brief/steps/`): no interpreter start and no `rg`, same blocks, same gating and budget. The installed `test-bodies` script is no longer started; `pixel plugin disable test-bodies` still switches it off. `workspace-overview` runs as a step as well (the manifests of a Cargo, npm, pnpm, Go or uv workspace), with the script as its oracle. So does `overview-answer-evidence` (what a named Cargo crate exposes, depends on and includes).
